movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Arms waved widely, right arm often raised higher than the left.
movement_profile.footwork: Syncopated stamps, knee movements, and leg kicks.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Solo or pair dancing in a circle.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Includes deep squats, jumping, and floor-level movements.
movement_profile.partnering: Can be performed as a solo or a dance duel.
movement_profile.posture: Upright, head tilted back, hands on hips or crossed over chest.

signature_moves.description: A deep squatting movement often involving leg kicks.
signature_moves.name: Prysiadka

music_profile.musical_form: Allegro, alternating tonic and dominant chords.
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Syncopated stamps on a quick duple meter.
music_profile.sound_description: A brisk, major-key allegro characterized by a driving, accelerating tempo and simple, alternating harmonic structure.

basic_steps: Entrance: Stand in a circle, hands on hips, head tilted back.
Syncopated stamp: Strike the ground with the sole of the foot.
Squatting: Perform knee-based movements and deep squats.
Spinning: Rotate in place while maintaining rhythm.
teaching.formation: Solo or pair in a circle.
teaching.level_notes: Requires high physical stamina and leg strength.
